description: The Phase 2 modelling, simulation and analysis programme runs: ARIES 1, MBL1, ARIES 2, TRAC AoA, HSI 1, HSI 2 and TRAC OE, with four vendor feedback events alongside. GAO printed p. 8 counts the result as "seven previously conducted analytical studies" and four soldier touchpoints — the report's "11 analytical efforts". The characteristics are unchanged; what changes is the evidence under them.
source: OMFV Industry Day briefing, 9 December 2020, PDF p. 17 (slide footer 19) and PDF p. 18 (slide footer 20); GAO-23-106549 printed p. 8 (PDF p. 11)
